The Format

How WomenHack events work

A curated evening of real conversations — no booths, no job boards, no spam.

1

Apply for Invite

Create a free profile. Our team reviews and sends curated invites to matched candidates.

2

Attend the Event

Spend an evening meeting up to 15 inclusive employers in rapid one-on-one rounds.

3

Choose Your Matches

After the event, select the companies you want to continue conversations with.

4

Get Hired

No placement fees, no middlemen. Introductions are made and you take it from there.

Women have been hired at

For Employers

Hire diverse engineering talent in one evening

WomenHack private and public events put your team face-to-face with pre-screened women in tech who are actively looking for their next role.

  • Meet up to 50 curated candidates in a single evening
  • No hiring fees, no placement costs — ever
  • 3–4× higher response rates than cold outreach
  • Events in 120+ cities across 6 continents
  • Private events available for targeted hiring goals
Hire Now
FAQ

Common questions

Yes — attending as a candidate is always free. We never charge placement fees or commissions. Employers pay a ticket fee to participate.
Sign up and create your profile. Our team reviews applications and sends curated invites based on your skills and the companies attending each event.
Both. We run in-person speed networking events in 120+ cities worldwide, and also host virtual events accessible globally.
You'll spend an evening rotating through rapid one-on-one conversations with representatives from hiring companies. After the event, you choose which companies to continue talking to — no pressure, no spam.
WomenHack is open to all professionals who support diversity in tech. While our focus is on women and underrepresented groups, allies are welcome.
Create an employer account and reserve your spot at upcoming events. You can also request a private event tailored to your specific hiring goals.
We operate in 120+ cities across North America, Europe, South America, and beyond — including San Francisco, New York, London, Berlin, Toronto, and more. Check the events list above for upcoming locations.
